actual_scope: Under the stated hypotheses (shortest rank-one root, interval masks, y live on A and the host, singleton hosts), prove D_root >= f(8L+1) + 2 sum_{m=1..g}[f(8m+1)-f(8m-8)], f(x)=x ln x, L=2g, with equality for chain(g|g) and its outer-nested twin only; unbalanced chains are strictly worse; at L=18 the bound is 1418.8458829 per port. Dropping the y-liveness hypothesis was decided exactly at L=4 and 6 (no gain when every site is covered); an uncovered pivot at one thin query saves 0.43858 at L=4,6 and is stated as scope, as is the doubleton-host case.
scope_change_reason: The card asks for a joint helper basis and a legal causal split on the complete invoice. This package is a structural optimality statement about the root mask family of the 9|9 chain-nested root; it builds no word and prices nothing.
bottleneck_link: docs/research/research-family-status.md; the statement fixes a necessary condition on the owned-move events of any legal native and which end-shortening edits of the #6833 owned layer it excludes.
stop_rule: No kappa claim. The bound is a theorem of the stated model (hypotheses H, R1, R2, R3) with exhaustive exact checks for the R2-dropped and doubleton cases at small L only. It does not cover non-coordinate masks, D-dependent bases, non-shortest roots, rank-above-one units, the uncovered-pivot case at t=1 for larger L, or doubleton hosts beyond L=8. No word is constructed and nothing is priced.
evidence: README.md (statement and proof), check.py (bound versus chain and twin at L=4..18, unbalanced chains, staircase over all sign patterns L<=16, exhaustive sign-model minima L=4..18 including 697.2194902789 at L=18, six uncovered-pivot savings), supp/ (decision logs).
